flags.dependence: Statistics are correlated, which can make F vary more than a binomial count; the expectation is unchanged under exchangeability without ties. Memory carries across weeks, so weeks are serially dependent and a binomial reference is approximate.
flags.ties: Equal values occupy a tied rank interval; equality with a reference extreme is never flagged.

limitations: Exploratory; no hypothesis test or calibrated anomaly claim.
References are deterministic transformations of the same inflow, not independent sources.
2/9 is conditional on exchangeability and no ties; many weekly flags are expected.
Outcome predictability is within-episode forward association, not evidence of external anticipation.
